Migration map

01 Interface Field Guide Broad contemporary UI direction, reusable patterns, and visual references beyond generic SaaS styling. 02 Adoption Lane Decision Instrument Provenance, gates, uncertainty, route logic, and equal No-Go outcomes for the stricter method lane. 03 Case Component Atlas The shared shell across project, change, and consulting domains. 04 Specialized Components Inputs, money, evidence, people, statistics, and structured states. 05 Analytical Components Polished ranges, discrete judgment, intervals, and production-library references. 06 Typography + Color Lab Interactive type roles, semantic color, density, contrast, and realistic previews. 07 Page Compositions Heroes, portfolio views, workspaces, decision reviews, dossiers, and mobile. 08 Interaction + Behavior Save, carry forward, supersede, skip, conclude, reopen, and conflict behavior. 09 Object Model How cases, stages, claims, evidence, judgments, decisions, and artifacts connect. 10 State Machine Case and stage states with explicit prerequisites and consequences. 11 Content + UX Writing Precise interface language and explicit origins for information. 12 Accessibility Lab Stress-test grayscale, projection, zoom, mobile, long labels, and reduced motion. 13 Motion Language Motion for causality: saving, carrying, superseding, revealing, and route travel.
Prototype brutally. Formalize selectively. Extract only after proof.
